purpose: Sequential access simulated using direct access
alt: 직접 접근으로 구현한 reset·read_next·write_next와 현재 위치 cp
prompt: Create ONE original raster PNG technical educational diagram for a Korean IT blog. White opaque background, navy readable sans-serif text, flat blue/teal boxes, generous whitespace. Use only the exact subject and components below. No logos, watermark, decorative illustrations, unrelated graphs, extra numeric values or invented facts. Redesign composition rather than copy source. Every connection must be accurate and labels fully readable.  Title Sequential access using direct access. Original flat clean two-column table Sequential operation | Direct-access implementation. Exactly three rows: reset | cp = 0; ; read_next | read cp; newline cp = cp + 1; ; write_next | write cp; newline cp = cp + 1; . Render code in monospaced font readable. Footer cp = current position (pseudocode). Never increment before read/write.
